title.rule: An exact lowercase title key with a nonempty double-quoted value emits one direct h1 child of comments-box. The heading text is HTML-escaped. Empty, single-quoted, bare, and wrong-case forms emit no custom heading.

hide.rule: Saved pages owned by exact hide=true invocations serve a visible Show Comments link and an empty thread-container. Omitted hide and exact hide=false serve the populated discussion and hide comments-options-hidden with display:none.
hide.remaining_ambiguity: PagePreview cannot distinguish invalid, wrong-case, single-quoted, bare, or empty hide forms on a saved page. Saved rendering must not query for those forms.

order.rule: Exact order=reverse marks thread-container with reverse and selects the newest ten root comment trees. Omitted order and exact order=forwards select the oldest ten. Invalid authored forms keep the default shell and do not establish a saved-page query.

hide_form.rule: The anonymous actor sees an Add a New Comment link and no open form for exact hideForm=true owners and for omitted or false controls.
hide_form.remaining_ambiguity: The documentation conditions auto-open behavior on actor permission. Anonymous evidence cannot establish the member form state or the accepted yes value.

controls_and_authority.rule: Captured bodies contain Show Comments, Hide All Comments, Add a New Comment, Edit, and Delete controls. No action request was sent, so the evidence does not authorize a form, browser handler, CSRF policy, or mutation.
